segments.text: Case number 19 TC 207305, Scott G. Loggins, charged speeding 20 over. Mr. Loggins, how do you wish to plead? Guilty, your honor. State recommends $150 fine, $90 court costs. The court accepts the plea. Defendant pleads guilty, fine $150 plus costs, due in 30 days, no jail. You'll receive payment instructions before you leave. Anything else? No, your honor. Next case. Status is completed. 19 TI 207296, Austin J. Wilson, no proof of insurance. Mr. Wilson, do you have proof today? I purchased the policy yesterday, but I don't have the card. State is willing to review for compliance. All right, matter continued for state review. Next court date, October 21st, 2025 at 9 o'clock AM. Bring proof then. Noted, your honor. Event status continued. 19 TC 207285, Stephanie McGray, speeding 15 over. First call, no response. Second call for Ms. McGray, no response. State moves for bench warrant. Record will reflect the defendant failed to appear. Motion for granted bench warrant to issue with standard bond. Event status, failure to appear. Case status to bench warrant. 19 TI 207276, Barbara Craig, expired registration. Ms. Craig, have you renewed? Renewal is in process. State requests a short continuance for proof. Granted, matter continued. Set status review date, November 4th, 2025 at 9 o'clock AM. Bring proof of renewal. Noted, event status continued. 18 TI 207256, Roger Ullman, equipment violation, broken taillight. Proof of correction? Yes, your honor. Receipt and a photo. State moves to dismiss upon compliance. Granted, case dismissed on compliance. Event status completed. 18 TC 207245, Anna Walter, careless driving. Ms. Walter, plea guilty. State recommends a $200 fine traffic school option. The court accepts the plea. Defendant pleads guilty. Fine $200 plus costs. Traffic school authorized within 60 days. Completion will avoid points. Event status completed. 18 TI 207236, Jeffrey Parsons, no insurance. Diversion offer. Proof of six month policy and administrative fee. Mr. Parsons, do you accept diversion? Yes, your honor. Accepted. Matter continued for diversion compliance. Set review December 9th, 2025 at 9 o'clock AM. Status is continued. 18 TC 207225, Camille Constable, failure to yield. State moves to dismiss. Officer unavailable and VO inclusive. Motion granted. Case dismissed. Event status completed. 18 TI 207216, Whitney W. Sally, speeding 10 over. First call, no response. Second call for Ms. Sally, no response. The record will reflect the defendant failed to appear. And that concludes the docket.
